answer: Use proof-of-unique-work with a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the key and the current epoch. To stay listed, each agent must submit a fresh solution every epoch, and verifiers recheck it cheaply with one hash path. Work cannot be reused across keys or epochs, so a haven of many fake agents must pay full compute for each one. Every identity needs about eight GB of RAM for an hour, roughly two dollars daily. Like jade carved from raw stone or pigment ground per batch, each key requires its own labor.
